ui.title: Wheel of Fate
ui.intro: Spin the wheel. Win a treat, or hear what the spirits have to say about your future.
ui.note: Turn your sound on for the full experience
ui.welcomeBack: Welcome back. The wheel is waiting…
ui.wheelDesc: 12 slices: 3 treats, 1 grand prize, 7 fortunes and 1 spin again.
ui.treatBody: Show this screen to your host to claim your sweet reward.
ui.grandBody: In a hundred years, Madame Nocturne has seen this only thrice. Find your host right away.
ui.grandGoneEyebrow: The golden hourglass is already claimed
ui.grandGoneBody: The spirits won’t send you away empty-handed. Show this screen to your host for your treat.
ui.catEyebrow: The black cat changed its mind
ui.catBody: Fate gives you another turn. The wheel is waiting.
